prompt: The camera does not move. Brandon, small in the frame from high above, does one slow crunch up and down on the floor, his brows pinched and his jaw tight, then a second shaky one. Later, he pauses at the top, lets his shoulders sag, and glances sideways at the laptop. The bare bulb flickers faintly. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: floorboards creaking under his back, a faint tinny voice murmuring from the laptop speaker, his breath puffing, the bulb buzzing. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
